ledger.x: 907: Ma Yin is created Prince of Chu.
908: Lang and Li prefectures fall to Ma Yin.
908: six prefectures of Liu Yin go to Chu.

wars.name: Southern Tang conquest of Chu
wars.outcome: Southern Tang took Tanzhou and deposed Ma Xi'e in December 951; Liu Yan's coalition of former Chu troops drove the Southern Tang out of Hunan in 952 (Bian Hao fled Tanzhou on 1 December 952), an 'embarrassing rout'.

wars.name: Chu-Southern Han wars over Guangxi
wars.outcome: 908: Chu captures six prefectures from Liu Yin; 911: Liu Yin takes Rong and Gao prefectures from Ma Yin ('Ma lost Ningyuan territory'); 928: Ma sent a fleet to attack Feng Prefecture and 'was defeated by Southern Han'.

wars.name: Chu-Hongnong (Yang Wu) and Jingnan wars
wars.outcome: No lasting change on the opened page: Yue fell to Huainan in 906 and was regained in 907; Ji was lost in 909 and Yuan in 914; in 919 'Chu forces attacked Jingnan, and Gao Jixing sought aid from Wu'; Wu's Li Jian captured Chu's Fu Prefecture and Chu withdrew.

certainty.note: No treaty line on any opened page; the Guangxi frontier with Liu Yin's Qinghai circuit and the later Southern Han is prefecture-named only, and the outline is Cliopatria's cut back to the page's 'Hunan and northeastern Guangxi'.
